description: Score a cold email (subject and body) out of 10 against the rules Pipefire checks its own emails with: length, reading level, the ask, subject line, and spam-filter wording. Returns each issue with why it matters and how to fix it.

body.description: The email body as plain text, including the greeting and sign-off. Merge fields like {{firstName}} are fine.

kind.description: Which email in the sequence: first (default), follow-up or last. Follow-ups are allowed to be shorter.

subject.description: The subject line exactly as it would be sent, e.g. "quick question".

name: check_cold_email

readingGrade.description: US school grade needed to read it. Aim for 6 or lower.

spamScore.description: Spam-filter risk out of 10 (higher is safer).

toolUrl.description: The same check as a free web tool on pipefire.ai.

title: Cold email checker
